categories.name: Tactile material identity and UV/texture discipline
categories.justification: Material families remain visibly separate across the mandatory views and neutral diagnostics: matte plaster/paint, controlled steel, dark rubber, diffusing glass, textile, paper and restrained plastic. Trolley textile holds broad folds and subdued weave. Checker confirms usable broad surface mapping and no visible missing coverage or catastrophic textile stretch. Localized cabinet and crate-contact finish variation exists. Remaining polish concerns are broad indiscriminate floor clouding, close-range coarse plaster, and mechanically repeated chair crease/panel finish treatment. Thin cylindrical hardware shows local checker anisotropy/density disparity, but no corresponding beauty texture defect is established; it is not counted as a critical stretch.

categories.name: Approved spawn colour coherence and restrained accents
categories.justification: All room views retain the approved spawn's muted mauve/off-white plaster, navy/charcoal lower/structural mass, cool steel, restrained orange institutional/functional grouping and sparse useful yellow/green/red indications. The dock is colder and more grey-weighted, consistent with its bleak brief. No colour confetti or broad saturated sci-fi glow. The bright pale/salmon scanner header and extensive yellow route paint carry more visual weight than the darker orange/cream grouping elsewhere, limiting perfect palette integration, while remaining functional.

remaining_findings.finding: Broad cloudy floor variation occupies used routes and quiet corners alike; local traffic/contact history is weak relative to the generalized mottling.
Plaster relief becomes coarse beside the check-in opening at close interaction distance; it remains localized and does not dominate the full room.
Chair horizontal creases and scanner panel perimeter treatment look somewhat mechanically repeated. The chair checker does not establish UV stretching as the cause.

Thin tubes, rollers, chair posts and bin sidewalls show elongated/fine striped checker cells and density changes; seams/repetition at independent parts are not automatically defects. No corresponding stretched noise/labels is visible in beauty or neutral pixels. Not counted as critical or as blanket UV failure.
Scanner pale/salmon header and extensive route yellow sit slightly apart in value/weight from the darker orange and cream supporting palette; functional coherence remains strong.

limits: Only categories 4 and 6 evaluated; these passing category scores do not establish overall 99/100 acceptance.
No native geometry, material graphs, code, author rationale, old scores, old reports, handoff, task state, repair plans or concepts used for visual credit.
Source and renderer were hashed only; no Blender source opened, no source/recipe mutations, no runtime claims.
Diagnostic checker seams/density alone do not prove an actual beauty stretch defect.
